data.title: Project Manager, Infrastructure
data.summary: Run multi-package infrastructure projects with disciplined interfaces, live operations, and a clean handover.
data.description: You will manage electrical and utility projects where the plant cannot stop. Success means predictable shutdown windows, honest reporting, coordinated vendors, and an operating team that is ready on day one.
responsibilities: Own scope, schedule, cost, and interface management.
Coordinate vendors and internal engineering disciplines.
Plan shutdowns around live operations and contingency.
Report progress with evidence, not optimism.
requirements: 7+ years managing industrial or infrastructure projects.
Clear written and verbal communication in Thai and English.
